root_cause_explanation: The pagination function subtracts one from the exclusive slice stop, so every full page omits its final item. The stop must be start + page_size.
unified_diff:
--- a/off_by_one_pagination.py
+++ b/off_by_one_pagination.py
@@ -6,3 +6,3 @@
     start = page * page_size
-    stop = start + page_size - 1
+    stop = start + page_size
     return items[start:stop]
